2609.17040.title: Sparse MLLM Anchors, Dense Adaptation: Breaking the Self-Referential Loop in Wild Test-Time Adaptation
2609.17040.paper_summary: Wild test-time adaptation (WTTA) updates a source model online under small test batches, concurrent distribution shifts, and time-varying class imbalance. Most WTTA methods derive their adaptation signals, including predictive uncertainty, sample reliability, and local feature geometry, from the model being adapted. When the source model is unreliable under shift, these signals can reinforce its own errors, forming a self-referential loop. We introduce MASA (Multimodal-LLM-Anchored Semantic Adaptation), which complements model-internal evidence with structured semantic descriptions from a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM). To limit inference cost, MASA queries the MLLM only for a small set of diverse, reliability-ranked anchors. The resulting descriptions capture the object family and nuisance factors such as style, viewpoint, and occlusion. MASA encodes these descriptions, propagates them to neighboring test samples, and stores the resulting visual-semantic information in an online prototype memory. Descriptor-aware retrieval from this memory provides an auxiliary target for lightweight adaptation of normalization-affine parameters. We evaluate MASA on the WTTA ImageNet-C benchmark under limited-batch, mixed-domain, and imbalanced-label-shift settings with ResNet and ViT backbones.
2609.17040.paper_summary_zh: 野外測試時間適應（WTTA）在小型測試批次、同時的分佈變化和時間變化的類別不平衡下，對源模型進行在線更新。大多數WTTA方法從被適應的模型中推導其適應信號，包括預測不確定性、樣本可靠性和局部特徵幾何。當源模型在變化下不可靠時，這些信號可能會加強其自身的錯誤，形成自我參照的循環。我們引入MASA（多模態LLM錨定語義適應），它用來自凍結的多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）的結構化語義描述來補充模型內部證據。為了限制推理成本，MASA僅對一小組多樣化、可靠性排名的錨點查詢MLLM。生成的描述捕捉了物體家族和風格、視角以及遮擋等干擾因素。MASA編碼這些描述，將其傳播到相鄰的測試樣本，並將生成的視覺-語義信息存儲在在線原型記憶中。從這個記憶中進行描述符感知檢索為輕量級的正規化仿射參數適應提供了一個輔助目標。我們在有限批次、混合領域和不平衡標籤變化設置下，使用ResNet和ViT骨幹對MASA進行了在WTTA ImageNet-C基準上的評估。
